articles.title: How one northern Alberta town is bracing for wildfires this spring
articles.summary: A specialized High Level Wildland Urban Interface (WUI) crew in northern Alberta used drip torches to ignite dead grass near a community. articles.title: Aircraft integration & flight testing complex to come up in Puttaparthi, Andhra Pradesh
articles.summary: The Aeronautical Development Agency (ADA), under DRDO, is establishing a world-class aircraft integration and flight testing complex in Puttaparthi. This crucial infrastructure will significantly enhance India's indigenous defence aviation capabilities by facilitating advanced research, development, and rigorous flight testing of future military aircraft. It marks a vital step towards achieving self-reliance in aerospace technology for national security.
